cards.label: What the portal does: capture, offline, reports, review, media and access

items.title: Every stage, one form
items.body: The stage set is declared once, as data, and drives the capture form, the completeness gate and the report.

items.title: No signal, no problem
items.body: The Android app records, queues and writes the finished report on the phone, then syncs when it can.

items.title: .docx and PDF
items.body: One shared document model renders prose, tables and photographs to Word and PDF, on the server and on the phone.

items.title: Rounds and inspection
items.body: Reviewers rate, comment and clear each round, and every decision is kept with who made it and when.

items.title: Interviews that transcribe
items.body: Recordings, photos and video upload resumably and interviews come back as editable, speaker-labelled transcripts.

items.title: Who may do what
items.body: Roles, consent and scoped data grants are enforced on every route, web and Android alike.
